card.name: Words inside US government and law text
card.fires_on: Linking words and spaces in US federal policy, civil rights and agency text, such as 'Summary of', 'receiving federal funds', 'supported by the Agency', or the space before a year in a date.

modes.label: Linking words in law text
modes.description: Small words like of, from, by, receiving inside names of federal acts, sections and agencies.
modes.example: Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 requires that programs<< receiving>> federal funds make their facilities accessible.

modes.label: Space before a date number
modes.description: The space after a month name, just before the day or year in a quote or report citation.
